'''August 2002 Tri-County tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Tri County on 11 August 2002. [[Brad Vogel]] won it. It is known from Scott Gurien's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3912">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-08-15-8-11-last-shot-before-colleged3912/ 8-11-last-shot-before-college], DeckTech (scott "isleshcky" gurien, 15 August 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-08-15-8-11-last-shot-before-colleged3912/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 11 August 2002
* '''Site:''' Tri County
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Brad Vogel]]
